info.name: Maintenance Tracker
info.summary: Keep track of maintenance schedules, service history, parts, and costs
info.description:
Maintenance Tracker keeps the upkeep of your vehicles, home, appliances, tools, medical devices, and other equipment in your own Nextcloud.
- **Schedules and due dates** by calendar interval, business days, or meter readings such as mileage, runtime hours, or usage counts - **Service history** with the work done, meter values, notes, and parts used - **Parts, vendors, and costs**, with optional tax lines and multiple currencies - **Receipts, photos, and documents** stored in Nextcloud Files - **Shared workspaces** with Owner, Manager, Contributor, and Viewer roles - **Reminders** through Nextcloud notifications, the Activity app, and an optional calendar of your choice - **Maintenance profiles** to set up common schedules and parts in one step - **Export and restore** as JSON or a ZIP with spreadsheet-friendly CSV files
The app makes no outgoing network requests; your data stays on your server.
This is a pre-release version: some features are available only through the API, and the interface is English only for now.
Privacy policy: https://github.com/thystra/maintenance_tracker/blob/main/docs/privacy-policy.md
info.author: Alan Johnson
